name: NeuS Weight Function
definition: A volume rendering technique that derives an unbiased and occlusion-aware weight function w(t) from a Signed Distance Function (SDF) f(x) to reconstruct surfaces from multi-view images without explicit 3D supervision.
summary: The NeuS weight function derives occlusion-aware, unbiased rendering weights from Signed Distance Functions to enable accurate surface reconstruction without explicit 3D supervision.
